value.rationale: Responds to source-observed invasion-triggered total collapse with an exact nonlocal finite-inoculum boundary, not just equilibrium algebra. The threshold handles every positive resident asymmetry, quantifies a physically motivated sensitivity to rarity of a mutualistic partner, demonstrates insufficiency of negative rare-invasion fitness, and predicts universal algebraic biomass decay. The beta-law power is sensitive to actual cross-benefit ratio c/a and informative for robustness.
